original_ai_output.title_zh: APC谴责针对NDC的袭击，敦促警方逮捕肇事者
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚全体进步大会党（APC）总统竞选委员会谴责近期发生在该国部分地区的政治集会袭击事件，其中包括拉各斯一场尼日利亚民主大会党（NDC）市政厅会议遭扰乱。APC竞选委员会发言人Dele Alake呼吁各政党、政客及其支持者保持克制，避免在竞选活动升温之际引发危机和公共秩序混乱。据报道，2027年1月16日总统选举前该国部分地区已出现政治暴力，引发对政治集会及支持者安全的担忧。

key_facts.fact: APC总统竞选委员会谴责近期针对政治集会的袭击，包括拉各斯一场NDC市政厅会议遭扰乱
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The All Progressives Congress Presidential Campaign Council has condemned recent attacks on political gatherings in parts of the country, including the disruption of a Nigeria Democratic Congress town hall meeting in Lagos

key_facts.fact: APC呼吁安全机构逮捕并起诉肇事者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: called on security agencies to arrest and prosecute those responsible

key_facts.fact: APC发言人Dele Alake呼吁各政党及支持者保持克制，避免引发危机和公共秩序混乱
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: urged political parties, politicians and their supporters to exercise restraint and avoid actions capable of triggering crises and public disorder

key_facts.fact: 拉各斯一场由NDC支持者组织的市政厅会议遭袭击者扰乱
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: On Friday, a town hall meeting organised by supporters of the NDC in Lagos was disrupted by attackers

key_facts.fact: 2027年1月16日总统选举前该国部分地区已报告政治暴力
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Political violence has been reported in parts of the country ahead of the January 16, 2027, presidential election

uncertainties: 袭击者身份及动机尚未确认
事件细节仅来自单一来源（Punch），尚缺乏交叉验证
政治暴力事件的具体范围与伤亡情况未获确认
